statement.p: How many integer solutions to x_1 + x_2 + x_3 + x_4 = 38 are there for which x_1 \ge 4\text{,} x_2 \ge 4\text{,} x_3 \ge 1\text{,} and x_4\ge 1\text{?}

solution.p: {31 \choose 28} solutions. First we guarantee the restrictions on the variables by distributing 10 units to the variables. Then we find all solutions to x_1' + x_2' + x_3' + x_4' = 28 in non-negative integers.
